# DAGSNet — một model cho mọi xe

<!-- generated by scripts/experiments_status.py from scenarios.json + results.csv; do not edit -->

- **Model:** DAGSNet W = 1, 395.408 tham số, 4 nhánh trên lưới 11 × 7.
- **Code:** core/, methods/, scripts/run_fl.py, scripts/run_central.py
- **Protocol:** 5.343 xe nhận = 5.343 client, mọi client mỗi round, 1 epoch local trên fold train + val, 50 round, batch 64, AdamW cosine 1e-3 → 1e-5; centralized 50 epoch, batch 4.096. Headline = round 50 (CANPerFL: 10 epoch fine-tune sau FedAvg r50), view theo bài gốc. [protocol](../../docs/research/protocol.md)
- **Tài liệu:** [results](../../docs/research/dagsnet/results.md), [protocol](../../docs/research/protocol.md), [cost](../../docs/research/cost.md)
